prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Pick a companion template to start your adoption process.", "Select your companion"]
1: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Quick tips to interact with your pet once it lands on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for settings menu, double-click to play, or hide in system tray"]
2: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "Building 3D models and animations...", "Did you know? Desktop pets love resting near your active windows!"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Scroll to discover standard companions or custom creation from your own photos.", "Choose companion path"]
4: ["Signing into your account safely syncs and protects all your adopted pets and data."]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to make their adoption official!", "Certified Desktop Pet", "Enter pet name"]
6: ["Feel free to minimize the app! We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready on desktop."]
7: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "Your pet is active! If it doesn't appear immediately on screen, check your taskbar tray icon or press Ctrl+Alt+P.", "Meet My Pet"]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Adopt a digital companion that lives and plays right on your computer desktop.", "Hi there! Ready to choose a friend?"]
9: ["For best pet generation, use well-lit photos with full front-facing view.", "Bright lighting\nClear frontal face view\nNo sunglasses or obstruction"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos of the user's face
